Also: Managed Care Program Annual Report · Managed Care Program Annual Reports

MEANING

The annual Managed Care Program Annual Report that states submit to CMS for each Medicaid managed care program. It contains program- and plan-level information across oversight topics.

EXAMPLE IN DECISIONPRO

DecisionPro uses Kentucky MCPAR responses as annual public signals for overpayments and encounter-data timeliness.
